regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Grace Panyard. I hope this find you with brighter out-look and more confidence in our Blessed Lord God. Many thanks for your many kind favors. I told Doris recently of a venerable candidate for Beatification, --- Countess Mary Therese Sedochoska, whose life I recently read. Doris said she wold a copy and get acquainted with her - and ask her to help. I am sure you will join with the rest of of us in learning to know her and in turning to her in all kind of emergency. Tell Georg not to get discouraged whatever turns he meet with. Instead of worrying - never any good - tell him, let us spend some of the time in gratefully thinking over some of the innumerable blessings Almighty God has surrounded us with and still surrounds with.
